body.name: TwinH
body.def: \(\mathcal W_H^{\mathrm{global}}=\{(\theta^+,\theta^-)\in\Theta_H^2:O_H(\theta^+)=O_H(\theta^-),\ T_{a,H}(\theta^+)\ne T_{a,H}(\theta^-)\}\). Equality of \(O_H\) means equality on every cell of \(\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^{+})\), and membership in \(\Theta_H^2\) imposes selector support exactly \(H\) for both models.
